examples.question_text: Let $f(x)=4x-3$ and $g(x)=2-3x$. Find and simplify (a) $f(g(x))$ and (b) $(g\circ f)(x)$.
Let $f(x)=x^{2}-2x+3$ and $g(x)=2x-1$. Find and simplify (a) $f(g(x))$ and (b) $g(f(x))$.
Let $f(x)=\sqrt{x}$ and $g(x)=x+5$. (a) Find $f(g(x))$ and $g(f(x))$. (b) Identify a composite function that produces $\sqrt{x+10}$.
examples.solution_text:
(a)
$\begin{align*}f(g(x))&=\sqrt{x+5}\\g(f(x))&=\sqrt{x}+5\end{align*}$
(b) Apply $g$ twice before applying $f$.
$\begin{align*}g(g(x))&=(x+5)+5\\&=x+10\\f(g(g(x)))&=\sqrt{x+10}\end{align*}$
The required composite function is $f(g(g(x)))$.

examples.question_text: Let $f(x)=\dfrac{2}{x+1}$ and $g(x)=\dfrac{1}{x}$. Find and simplify (a) $f(g(x))$ and (b) $g(f(x))$.
examples.solution_text:
(a) Substitute the whole fraction, then combine the denominator terms.
$\begin{align*}f(g(x))&=\dfrac{2}{\dfrac{1}{x}+1}\\&=\dfrac{2}{\dfrac{1+x}{x}}\\&=\dfrac{2x}{x+1}\end{align*}$
This composition requires $x\ne0,-1$.
(b)
$\begin{align*}g(f(x))&=\dfrac{1}{\dfrac{2}{x+1}}\\&=\dfrac{x+1}{2}\end{align*}$
This composition requires $x\ne-1$.

Substitute the full expression into both occurrences of $x$.
$\begin{align*}f(f(x))&=\dfrac{\dfrac{x}{x+2}}{\dfrac{x}{x+2}+2}\\&=\dfrac{\dfrac{x}{x+2}}{\dfrac{x+2(x+2)}{x+2}}\\&=\dfrac{\dfrac{x}{x+2}}{\dfrac{3x+4}{x+2}}\\&=\dfrac{x}{3x+4}\end{align*}$
The original composition requires $x\ne-2,-\dfrac{4}{3}$.

examples.question_text: Let $f(x)=\sqrt{x^{2}-16}$ and $g(x)=x+6$. Express $f(g(x))$ in the form $\sqrt{(x+a)(x+b)}$, where $a<b$ are integers.
examples.solution_text:
Substitute first, then factor the expression under the square root.
$\begin{align*}f(g(x))&=\sqrt{(x+6)^{2}-16}\\&=\sqrt{x^{2}+12x+36-16}\\&=\sqrt{x^{2}+12x+20}\\&=\sqrt{(x+2)(x+10)}\end{align*}$

examples.question_text:
Which function satisfies $f(f(x))=x$ for every input where the composition is defined?
A. $f(x)=x+2$
B. $f(x)=x-2$
C. $f(x)=\dfrac{x-2}{x+2}$
D. $f(x)=\dfrac{2x+3}{x-2}$
examples.solution_text:
Test each function by substituting its rule into itself.
For A:
$\begin{align*}f(f(x))&=(x+2)+2\\&=x+4\end{align*}$
For B:
$\begin{align*}f(f(x))&=(x-2)-2\\&=x-4\end{align*}$
For C:
$\begin{align*}f(f(x))&=\dfrac{\dfrac{x-2}{x+2}-2}{\dfrac{x-2}{x+2}+2}\\&=\dfrac{x-2-2(x+2)}{x-2+2(x+2)}\\&=\dfrac{-x-6}{3x+2}\end{align*}$
For D:
$\begin{align*}f(f(x))&=\dfrac{2\left(\dfrac{2x+3}{x-2}\right)+3}{\dfrac{2x+3}{x-2}-2}\\&=\dfrac{2(2x+3)+3(x-2)}{2x+3-2(x-2)}\\&=\dfrac{7x}{7}\\&=x\end{align*}$
For D, $x\ne2$, and the denominator of the outer function is $\dfrac{7}{x-2}$, which is nonzero.
Correct answer: D.

examples.question_text: Let $f(x)=\dfrac{px+q}{rx-p}$, where $r\ne0$ and $p^{2}+qr\ne0$. Show that $f(f(x))=x$ wherever the composition is defined.
examples.solution_text:
Substitute the whole fraction and multiply the numerator and denominator by $rx-p$.
$\begin{align*}f(f(x))&=\dfrac{p\left(\dfrac{px+q}{rx-p}\right)+q}{r\left(\dfrac{px+q}{rx-p}\right)-p}\\&=\dfrac{p(px+q)+q(rx-p)}{r(px+q)-p(rx-p)}\\&=\dfrac{p^{2}x+pq+qrx-pq}{rpx+rq-prx+p^{2}}\\&=\dfrac{(p^{2}+qr)x}{p^{2}+qr}\\&=x\end{align*}$
The cancellation is valid because $p^{2}+qr\ne0$. For $x\ne\dfrac{p}{r}$, the outer denominator is $\dfrac{p^{2}+qr}{rx-p}$, which is nonzero.

examples.question_text: Let $f(x)=\sqrt{x}$ and $g(x)=x^{2}-10x+25$. Find and simplify $f(g(x))$ for $x\ge5$.
examples.solution_text:
Substitute and factor the perfect-square radicand.
$\begin{align*}f(g(x))&=\sqrt{x^{2}-10x+25}\\&=\sqrt{(x-5)^{2}}\\&=|x-5|\end{align*}$
For real $u$, $\sqrt{u^{2}}=|u|$. Since $x\ge5$, $x-5\ge0$, so $f(g(x))=x-5$.

examples.derivation: f(g(x))=sqrt(x+5); g(f(x))=sqrt(x)+5. Applying g twice gives x+10, so f(g(g(x)))=sqrt(x+10).
f(g(x))=2/(1/x+1)=2x/(x+1), with x excluding 0 and -1. g(f(x))=1/(2/(x+1))=(x+1)/2, with x excluding -1.
f(f(x))=[x/(x+2)]/[x/(x+2)+2]=x/(3x+4). The inner rule excludes -2; the outer denominator excludes -4/3.

Self-composition gives A: x+4; B: x-4; C: (-x-6)/(3x+2); D: [2(2x+3)+3(x-2)]/[2x+3-2(x-2)]=7x/7=x. For D, x excludes 2 and the outer denominator is 7/(x-2), which never vanishes. Only D is identically x.

After clearing rx-p, the numerator is p(px+q)+q(rx-p)=(p^2+qr)x and the denominator is r(px+q)-p(rx-p)=p^2+qr. Their quotient is x. The stated nonzero factor permits cancellation, and x excluding p/r ensures both original evaluations exist.
